result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/content inconsistencies: the active 'Pizza' filter does not match the displayed results, a restaurant name is truncated, and a category chip is clipped at the screen edge without clear affordance.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is selected (highlighted dark), but the visible results are mostly non-pizza restaurants: Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, and Tokumaru Ramen Bar. Only one pizza item appears at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filter actually filters the restaurant lists, or visually deselect the chip if filtering is not applied to these sections.

issues.description: The third card title in 'Fastest near you' is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the card itself is cut off at the right edge with no visual scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis style intentionally or increase card width; consider adding a peek/gradient or scroll affordance to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge of the screen, showing only a small sliver of the pill.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/padding so partially visible chips show enough content to be recognizable, or add a fade gradient to indicate more chips are scrollable.

issues.description: 'Popular right now' shows Tokumaru Ramen Bar prominently with a '€0 delivery' badge duplicated in both the image overlay and the metadata line, which is redundant.
issues.suggestion: Show the '€0 delivery' indicator once (either as a badge or in the metadata row) to reduce visual clutter.
